title: Ramayana Box Office: 23 Din Mein 1,000 Crore Net Kamakar Baahubali 2 Ko Pachhada
summary: Ranbir Kapoor aur Yash starrer film Ramayana ne 23 din mein India mein 1,000.55 crore net earnings ki hain aur Baahubali 2 ko pichhe chhod diya hai.
key_points: Ramayana ne Day 23 tak worldwide Rs 1,790.10 crore ka gross collection kiya.
Baahubali 2 ke Rs 1,788.06 crore ke lifetime record ko pichhe chhoda.
India mein film ka net collection Rs 1,000.55 crore aur gross Rs 1,195.10 crore hua.
Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi aur Yash starrer film ka part 2 Diwali 2028 mein aayega.
body: Director Nitesh Tiwari ki film 'Ramayana: Part 1' ne box office par ek naya record banaya hai. Release ke 23rd day par film ne India mein 1,000 crore net collection ka milestone cross kar liya hai. Is kamai ke saath film ka total worldwide gross collection Rs 1,790.10 crore tak pahunch gaya hai.

Iss aakde ke saath Ramayana ne Prabhas ki film 'Baahubali 2' ke Rs 1,788.06 crore ke lifetime worldwide collection ko pichhe chhod diya hai. Ab yeh film sabse zyada kamai karne wali teesri Indian film ban gayi hai. Day 23 par film ne India mein Rs 8.45 crore net kamaye, jisme sabse bada hissa Hindi version ka raha.

Film ke overseas market ne bhi is mehatvapurna milestone tak pahunchne mein bada role nibhaya hai, jahan iska gross collection Rs 595 crore ho gaya hai. Sacnilk ke mutabiq, India mein Hindi ke ilawa Kannada, Tamil, Malayalam aur Telugu versions ne bhi steady earnings ki hain.

Prime Focus Studios, DNEG aur Monster Mind Creations ke under bani is film mein Ranbir Kapoor ne Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi ne Sita aur Yash ne Ravana ka role nibhaya hai. Is do-part cinematic project ka dusra part Diwali 2028 mein theatres mein aayega.
why_it_matters: Indian cinema history mein 1,000 crore net domestic collection achieve karna aur Baahubali 2 jaise record ko pichhe chhodna Indian box office ke naye scale ko darshata hai.
